## Purpose

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change belongs in its owning module.

## Evidence

- [ ] Focused tests cover success and failure behavior.
- [ ] `python scripts/release_check.py --strict-quality` passes, or unavailable host proofs are identified.
- [ ] API contracts, migrations, documentation, and store/privacy metadata are updated where applicable.
- [ ] UI changes include keyboard, accessibility, responsive, and reduced-motion evidence.

## Risk And Rollback

Describe compatibility, data migration, tenant-isolation, privacy, rollout, and rollback effects. Use `None` only when the claim is demonstrably true.

## Privacy Check

- [ ] No credentials, personal data, journal text, databases, vaults, logs, screenshots, local paths, or signing artifacts are included.
- [ ] New third-party processing and data collection are reflected in product disclosures.
